us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerE.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)
us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

us-gaap:GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit
us-gaap:GrossProfit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOut.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSh.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperating.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAn.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarrying.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

us-gaap:DebtCurrent.label: Debt, Current
us-gaap:DebtCurrent.description: Amount of short-term debt and current maturity of long-term debt and capital lease obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseOblig.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

us-gaap:LongTermDebt.label: Long-term Debt
us-gaap:LongTermDebt.description: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

us-gaap:DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.label: Debt and Lease Obligation
us-gaap:DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.description: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

us-gaap:ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
us-gaap:ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

qa_flags.impact: Per-share and share-count histories require a corporate-action review before valuation or cross-period modeling.
Debt amounts must be reconciled for lease coverage, complete borrowing scope and carrying value before an enterprise-value bridge.
Missing cells are not zero; source the relevant filing and exact definition before modeling.

limitations: Company Facts excludes custom taxonomy and dimensional/segment facts; absent data is not zero.
Company Facts does not carry the full filing context. Revisions may reflect restatements, stock splits, scope changes or tagging differences; flagged revisions are not automatically reconciled.
Fiscal labels come from primary filing focus and annual boundaries; SEC calendar frames are retained only as provenance.
Standalone quarters derived from cumulative values use exact matching fiscal starts/tags/units; cross-filing inputs are disclosed. EPS and weighted-average shares are never subtracted.

Debt lease coverage, short-term borrowings, principal versus carrying value, and unverified share cells require filing-level review before valuation. Explicit split reviews cover exact approved observations only; outstanding share classes remain outside those reviews.
Cash excludes marketable securities unless independently presented as short_term_investments. Cash plus investments is not assumed to be unrestricted cash.
This is a selected historical metric schedule, not complete statements, a three-statement model, consensus, forecasts or a valuation.
Full balance-sheet and cash-flow reconciliations are outside the selected metric scope and have not been performed.
